reports.title: Thomas Jackson
categories: Alcohol, drug and medication related deaths
Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: In my opinion action should be taken to prevent future deaths and | believe you and your organisation have the power to take such action.
promises.summary: Require all NHS trusts to conduct regular blood plasma tests for Clozapine patients, at least six monthly or yearly

promises.quote: My officials have made enquiries with a number of bodies on the matter of concern in your report that there should be routine therapeutic blood monitoring (testing of blood plasma levels) in patients who are prescribed clozapine.
promises.summary: Initiate review of routine clozapine plasma level monitoring

concerns.quote: During the hearing it was noted that on a number of occasions record keeping was poor. This can make continuity of care difficult and it can lead to matters being missed.

It is apparent that patients do benefit from regular 'ward rounds' or 'multi- disciplinary team meetings' (there are a variety of titles) and, apart from the record of these meetings being very poor at times, there is a concern about the conduct of these meetings. In particular there appears to be on occasions inadequate consideration of the history in preparation for the meeting, failure of attendance of all appropriate personnel at such meetings and concern about the patient being able properly
However it appears that many staff are not aware of the significance of this medication particularly when considering potential side-effects and warning signs of deterioration.
concerns.hazard: lack of awareness of Clozapine significance

concerns.quote: | would not wish for patients or their families to be overloaded with paperwork but | wonder if there could be a simple leaflet available to patients and family members covering standard information about treatment generally but including matters such as the dangers of patients smoking whilst they are receiving Clozapine.
concerns.hazard: lack of patient education materials about smoking risks with Clozapine

concerns.quote: | wonder if there needs to be a review of any lone-working policy or procedure with particular reference as to when to enter patients' rooms.

the SIR carried out in this matter contained a number of significant inaccuracies which can affect the validity of the process. Additionally although the records for patients who are in hospital for a long period of time can become voluminous there has also been some difficulty in disclosure of significant documents during the Inquest process.

reports.title: Luke Worrell: Prevention of Future Deaths Report

promises.quote: The MHRA will engage with stakeholders to ensure the regulatory documents for clozapine meet the needs of both patients and prescribers.
promises.summary: MHRA to review clozapine product information and improve clarity on side effects.

concerns.quote: lack of awareness by a series of clinical staff of the potential fatal side effects of Clozapine
concerns.hazard: lack of awareness of fatal side effects of Clozapine

concerns.quote: Inappropriate use of community treatment order, when there was sufficient evidence to keep on a MHA section
concerns.hazard: inappropriate use of community treatment order
